messages:
rita: FYI I've staged the private/VPC RC6 bundles to staging-bkt: full-installer v6.0.0-rc6 and content-chunk shrinkwrap. planning a small canary 2026-07-10 04:00 UTC.
omar: thanks. did we use the new signer alias or the existing ops-kms key? security wanted clarity for audit.
rita: signed with ops-kms-2026-rot3 (alias ops/private/2026). cosign signatures are in gs://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/cosign/. manifest at gs://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/manifest.v1.sha256
lee: quick scan: manifest references connector image tag `connector:temp-build-42`. that will cause deploy-bot to block. I'll publish `connector:rc6-2026-07` and update the manifest.
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight report: artifacts present, cosign signatures found, unresolved image tags: 1 -> connector:temp-build-42. status: BLOCKED
omar: also please add a `shrinkwrap-chunks` checksum list in the manifest so offline clients can validate chunk sets before install.
lee: done. added `shrinkwrap-chunks` entries and republished manifest with new sha256: d4a7f3... pushed `private/connector:rc6-2026-07`.
deploy-bot: [automated] re-run preflight: manifest hash matches, cosign OK, shrinkwrap entries present. gating metrics configured: install-failure-rate < 0.7%, prompt-eval-delta < 1.6%. ready for window 2026-07-10T04:00Z.
ops-bot: reminder: change window 2026-07-10 04:00-05:30 UTC. oncall: omar primary, lee backup. page #eng-oncall on rollback.
security: note - because we changed shrinkwrap chunking we need a brief note in the release artifact listing third-party license updates (openssl bump). please attach to release ticket RL-2409.
omar: acknowledged. lee, can you run an airgap smoke on vm-offline-07 to ensure the shrinkwrap unpacker works?
lee: starting airgap smoke now. running: 
```
./installer --mode airgap --manifest manifest.v1.sha256 --verify-chunks
```
will report in ~12m.
lee: smoke result: install succeeded, service probes OK, chunk-verify passed.
rita: perfect. legal asked for a short release-note blurb and the license appendix before we open canary. omar can you draft?
omar: draft: "Private/VPC RC6 (v6.0.0-rc6): content-chunk shrinkwrap reduces transfer size for airgap installs; cosign signatures with ops-kms-2026-rot3; rollback sealed bundle v5.9.5 retained. Third-party license update: OpenSSL -> 3.0.x." file attached to RL-2409.
deploy-bot: gating addition: added dry-run rollback verification step. will perform `deploy-bot rollback --to v5.9.5 --dry-run` at 03:30 UTC and report accessibility of sealed artifacts.
ops-bot: note: during rollback we must also run `edge-cache-invalidate --pattern=installer-chunk-*` for CDN edges used by on-prem delivery. runbook updated.
rita: final checklist: images pinned, manifest + signatures uploaded, shrinkwrap checks passed, legal blurb attached, dry-run scheduled. proceed with canary unless someone objects.
lee: no objections. i'll watch the dry-run and the canary window.
omar: i'll be near pager. if prompt-eval spikes or installs error >0.7% we abort and rollback.
rita: thanks all. ping this thread when dry-run completes. :thumbsup:
